1.1: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to y'all from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.2: We always thank God for you, mentioning you in our prayers,
1.3: Remembering without fail your work of faith, labor of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the presence of our God and Father.
1.4: We know, beloved brothers and sisters, that you've been chosen by God.
1.5: Our gospel didn't just come to you in words, but with power, the Holy Spirit, and full assurance, just like you saw what kind of men we were among you for your sake.
1.6: You followed us and the Lord, even though you received the word in the midst of suffering, but you still had the joy of the Holy Spirit.
1.7: Because of that, you became examples to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia. You showed them how it's done.
1.8: For from you, the word of the Lord has gone out, not just in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place. Your faith in God is so strong, we don't even need to say anything about it.
1.9: People are talking about us, saying how we came to you and how you turned to God from idols, to serve the living and true God,
1.10: And how you're waiting for His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus, who delivers us from the coming wrath.

2.1: Y'all know, brothers and sisters, that when we came to you, it wasn't for nothing.
2.2: Even after we got hurt and treated real foul in Philippi, as you know, we still stood strong in God and boldly preached the gospel to you, even though it came with a lot of struggle.
2.3: Our message didn't come from a place of error or impurity, nor was it fake.
2.4: We were approved by God to carry the gospel, and that's how we speak—not to please people, but to please God who checks our hearts.
2.5: We didn't use smooth talk or try to get anything outta y'all, like we see some do. God's our witness.
2.6: We didn't seek glory from men, not from you or anyone else, even though we could've flexed as apostles of Christ.
2.7: We were gentle with you, just like a nursing mother takes care of her kids.
2.8: We loved y'all so much, we didn't just give you the gospel of God, we gave you our lives too, 'cause you became so dear to us.
2.9: You remember, we worked hard for y'all—night and day, so we wouldn't be a burden, and we preached the gospel to you.
2.10: You're witnesses, and God is too, how we lived devout, just, and blameless among you who believe.
2.11: You know how we encouraged, comforted, and challenged each of you, like a father does his own children,
2.12: Telling you to walk worthy of God, who called you into His kingdom and glory.
2.13: For this reason, we thank God all the time, because when you received the word of God we preached, you didn't just take it as our words, but as the truth—it's the word of God, and it works in y'all who believe.
2.14: You, brothers and sisters, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea, who are in Christ Jesus. You even went through the same struggles from your own people, just like they did from the Judeans.
2.15: The same ones who killed Jesus and their own prophets, and now they're out here persecuting us too. They don't please God and they're against everyone.
2.16: They're stopping us from speaking to the Gentiles so they can be saved, always filling up the measure of their sins. But God's wrath is coming down on them, full force.
2.17: But we, brothers and sisters, even though we've been away from you physically for a little while, we still got y'all in our hearts and we've been wanting to see you badly.
2.18: We tried to come to y'all—even me, Paul—over and over, but Satan blocked us.
2.19: What's our hope, or joy, or crown that we'll be bragging about when Jesus comes back? Isn't it even you in His presence?
2.20: You are our glory and joy.

3.1: So when we couldn't stand it no more, we thought it was best to be left in Athens by ourselves,
3.2: And we sent Timothy, our brother, God's minister, and our fellow worker in the gospel of Christ, to build you up and encourage you about your faith,
3.3: So that none of y'all get shaken by all this trouble, 'cause you know we were appointed to go through this.
3.4: We told you when we was with you that we'd face struggles, and now you see it's happening, just like we said.
3.5: So, I couldn't take it anymore, I had to send to check on your faith, to make sure the tempter didn't get to y'all and mess up all the work we put in.
3.6: But now that Timothy came back from you, bringing us the good news of your faith and love, and how you're always remembering us, wanting to see us just like we wanna see you—
3.7: We're encouraged by your faith, even with all the trouble and distress we're going through.
3.8: For now, we alive, knowing you standing strong in the Lord.
3.9: What can we even thank God for you enough? We rejoice for y'all before God,
3.10: Praying day and night, wishing we could see your face and help you grow in your faith.
3.11: Now may our God and Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, lead us to you,
3.12: And may the Lord help you grow more and more in love for each other and for everyone, just like we love you,
3.13: So He can keep your hearts blameless in holiness before God, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints.

4.1: Alright then, brothers and sisters, we're urging y'all in the Lord Jesus to keep growing more and more, just like we showed you how to live to please God,
4.2: 'Cause you know what we taught you through the Lord Jesus.
4.3: This is God's will for you—your sanctification: Stay away from sexual immorality,
4.4: Each of you should know how to control your own body in sanctification and honor,
4.5: Not in the lustful passion, like the Gentiles who don't know God,
4.6: Don't take advantage of or cheat your brother in this, 'cause the Lord is the one who will punish all those who do that, just like we warned you before.
4.7: God didn't call us to live unclean, but to live holy.
4.8: So, if you reject this, you ain't rejecting people—you rejecting God, who gave us the Holy Spirit.
4.9: Now, about loving each other like brothers and sisters, I don't even need to say much—God's already teaching you to love each other.
4.10: And y'all already doing it to all the believers in Macedonia. But we're telling you, keep stepping it up.
4.11: Make it your goal to live a peaceful life, mind your own business, and work with your own hands, like we told you,
4.12: So that you can live in a way that earns respect from outsiders and not be lacking anything.
4.13: Now, I don't want y'all to be ignorant about those who have passed away, so you don't be sad like people who have no hope.
4.14: We believe that Jesus died and rose again, and just like that, God will bring with Him those who've fallen asleep in Jesus.
4.15: We're telling you this by the word of the Lord: We who are alive when Jesus comes back won't get there before those who've passed away.
4.16: For the Lord Himself will come down from heaven with a shout, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ will rise first.
4.17: Then we who are still alive will be caught up with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And we'll always be with the Lord.
4.18: So, comfort each other with these words.

5.1: Now, concerning the times and seasons, my people, I don't need to tell y'all much.
5.2: You already know that the Day of the Lord is gonna come like a thief in the night.
5.3: When they start talking 'bout "Peace and safety," that's when sudden destruction gon' hit them, like labor pains on a pregnant woman. They ain't gon' escape.
5.4: But y'all ain't in the dark, so that Day ain't gonna sneak up on you like a thief.
5.5: You are children of the light and children of the day. We ain't of the night or the darkness.
5.6: So don't be sleepin' like everybody else, but stay awake and stay sober.
5.7: People who sleep, sleep at night. People who get drunk, get drunk at night.
5.8: But we, who are of the day, gotta stay sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of salvation's hope.
5.9: God didn't choose us for wrath, but for salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
5.10: Who died for us, so that whether we're awake or sleep, we should live together with Him.
5.11: So, comfort each other and keep building each other up, just like y'all been doing.
5.12: Now, we're asking you, brothers and sisters, to recognize those who are working hard among you, who lead you in the Lord and give you guidance,
5.13: And show them mad love, for the work they're doing. Be peaceful with each other.
5.14: Now, we also urge you, warn the ones who are being wild, comfort those who are struggling, support the weak, and be patient with everybody.
5.15: Make sure nobody's paying back evil for evil. Always go after what's good, not just for yourself, but for everyone.
5.18: Give thanks in everything; this is what God wants from you in Christ Jesus.
5.21: Test everything; hold on to what's good.
5.22: Stay away from every form of evil.
5.23: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you all the way—your whole spirit, soul, and body, keeping you blameless until the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
5.24: The One who called you is faithful, and He's gonna make it happen.
5.25: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.
5.26: Greet all the believers with a holy kiss.
5.27: I'm charging you by the Lord: Make sure this letter is read to all the believers.
5.28: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
